title: Entrywise modular transformation
statement: For a Boolean list $w$, define its entrywise modular transformation by applying the modular-reduction operation to the pair encoding whose first component is the decoded second component of $w$ and whose second component is the decoded first component of $w$.
caveat: The definitions of the pair encoding, component decoders, and modular-reduction operation are not included, so their meanings cannot be stated more specifically.
